title: Reservation under Chen
setting: Maya is checking into a mid-range hotel in the late afternoon. Anita at the front desk is at the end of a long shift, still decent.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Yeah. I have a reservation under Chen. Maya Chen.
lines.spoken: Yeah. I have a reservation under Chen. Maya Chen.

lines.speaker: anita
lines.text: Chen... okay, give me a second. Yeah, I see you. One night, queen, yeah?
lines.spoken: Chen... okay, gimme a second. Yeah, I see you. One night, queen, yeah?

lines.speaker: anita
lines.text: Oh. Let me look again. ...Yeah, you're right, two nights. Sorry. Can I see an ID and the card you're using?
lines.spoken: Oh. Lemme look again. ...Yeah, you're right, two nights. Sorry. Can I see an ID and the card you're using?

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Sure. Here. The card's the same one I booked with.
lines.spoken: Sure. Here. The card's the same one I booked with.

lines.speaker: anita
lines.text: Perfect. You're in 412. Elevators are around the corner, ice machine on four if you care.
lines.spoken: Perfect. You're in 412. Elevators are around the corner, ice machine on four if you care.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: I care. Thank you. Is breakfast a thing here, or...?
lines.spoken: I care. Thank you. Is breakfast a thing here, or...?

lines.speaker: anita
lines.text: There's coffee and some sad pastries from seven to ten. I won't oversell it.
lines.spoken: There's coffee and some sad pastries from seven to ten. I won't oversell it.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: That's honest. Okay. Do I get two keys?
lines.spoken: That's honest. Okay. Do I get two keys?

lines.speaker: anita
lines.text: I'll do two. Here you go. Wi-Fi password's on the little card in the sleeve. If something's weird with the room, just come back down, I'll fix it.
lines.spoken: I'll do two. Here you go. Wi-Fi password's on the little card in the sleeve. If something's weird with the room, just come back down, I'll fix it.

lines.speaker: anita
lines.text: Enjoy, as much as a person can enjoy a hotel. You're all set.
lines.spoken: Enjoy, as much as a person can enjoy a hotel. You're all set.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: I'll try. Have a good rest of your shift.
lines.spoken: I'll try. Have a good rest of your shift.

gist.askZh: 前台是怎样的人？气氛怎么样？

details.askZh: 预订是几晚？房间号是多少？
details.askEn: How many nights is the reservation, and what's the room number?

details.askZh: 早餐和钥匙分别怎么说的？
details.askEn: What do they say about breakfast and keys?
accept: coffee and pastries from seven to ten
七点到十点有咖啡和点心

glue.span: I have a reservation under Chen

glue.noteZh: under 在这里不是‘在下面’，是‘记在谁的名下’；have a 弱读，关键词是 reservation under + 姓。
glue.standard: I have a reservation under Chen

glue.noteZh: Can I see an 里 can 和 an 都弱，ID 要听成字母 I-D，不是一个单词 id。
You're in 很短，房间号常按数字位来念：four twelve，不是 four hundred twelve。

roleplay.setupZh: 你在酒店前台办理入住。报预订名，核对是几晚，出示证件和卡，并顺口问早餐、钥匙、无线网这类实际问题。
roleplay.aiRole: Anita, a human front-desk clerk at the end of a long shift. Friendly, slightly dry, not scripted. She may misread the reservation as one night and then correct it. She will not oversell breakfast.
variants: The reservation is under a different name (a friend's card).
The room type is wrong and Anita has to switch it.
starters: I have a reservation under Chen.

fluency.promptZh: 讲讲入住过程：预订名是什么，一开始晚上数有没有弄错，房间号，早餐和钥匙怎么安排。准备 15 秒，然后 60、45、30 秒。
fluency.promptEn: Tell the check-in: the name on the reservation, the nights mix-up, the room number, and what they said about breakfast and keys. Prep 15 seconds, then 60, 45, 30.
